page_title: SHU 2-2 CHE | Sheffield Utd v Chelsea 07/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Robert Jones is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+8' Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Jones had an easy-decision to make.
90+7' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
90+7' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
90+3' 2 - 2 GOAL! Cameron Archer meets a cross inside the box and heads the ball across the goal, where Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) lurks and pokes it into the back of the net. 2:2.
90+3' We are about to witness a substitution. Cesare Casadei (Chelsea) is replacing Nicolas Jackson.
90+3' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Marc Cucurella as he is replaced by Benoit Badiashile (Chelsea).
90+1' Chris Wilder is forced to make a change. Jack Robinson is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd).
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Jack Robinson (Sheffield Utd) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
89' Robert Jones shows a yellow card to Ollie Arblaster (Sheffield Utd) for his blatant foul.
88' Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
88' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) takes the corner, but it's intercepted by the defender.

88' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear. Sheffield Utd force a corner. They send men into the box.

87' Jack Robinson (Sheffield Utd) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the right side of the target, but Djordje Petrovic keeps the ball out. Now Sheffield Utd have a corner.
87' Chris Wilder prepares a substitution. Auston Trusty is replaced by Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd).
86' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Robert Jones had an easy-decision to make.
85' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
85' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Chelsea.
85' Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
84' The resulting set piece from Chelsea is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
82' The substitution is prepared. Mykhailo Mudryk (Chelsea) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Noni Madueke.
80' Chris Wilder (Sheffield Utd) gets a yellow card, off the field.
79' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
79' The resulting corner from Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) is cleared.
78' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) floats the ball in from the corner but it's intercepted. Sheffield Utd have been awarded a corner kick.

78' Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it. The ball is out of play. Sheffield Utd win a corner kick.
77' Ivo Grbic displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
76' Chris Wilder has decided to substitute Mason Holgate and he is replaced by James McAtee (Sheffield Utd).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Carney Chukwuemeka (Chelsea) comes onto the pitch for Cole Palmer.
73' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

72' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) connected with a pass around the edge of the box, aimed and shot. His attempt went towards the roof of the net, but Ivo Grbic was alert and the score remains the same. Chelsea have been awarded a corner kick.
72' Chelsea take a short corner kick.
71' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. It will be a corner kick for Chelsea.
70' Ollie Arblaster (Sheffield Utd) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Robert Jones no option but to blow his whistle.
66' 1 - 2 Noni Madueke (Chelsea) makes a great solo run and pulls the trigger from inside the box, beating Ivo Grbic with a strike under the crossbar. He makes it 1:2.
64' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) has a go from the edge of the box, but it's a harmless effort and sails well wide of the left post.
64' The ball is cleared after Cole Palmer (Chelsea) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
64' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) commits a rough foul. Robert Jones stops the game and makes a call.
62' Thiago Silva (Chelsea) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the underside of the crossbar is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
62' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.
61' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Chelsea.
61' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
60' Robert Jones couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Auston Trusty (Sheffield Utd) and blew his whistle.
58' Robert Jones shows a yellow card to Jack Robinson (Sheffield Utd) for his blatant foul.
57' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 8:3.
54' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) finds himself with a great opportunity! He unleashes a shot from the edge of the box, which whizzes just wide of the left post!
52' Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) has tested the patience of referee Robert Jones and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
52' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
51' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery.

49' Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) in a great chance! He climbs highest deep in the penalty box and strikes with a powerful header towards the net. Next time he should aim better. His effort ends wide of the right post.
49' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
47' The corner from Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) is intercepted by Djordje Petrovic.

47' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) inside the box following a slide rule pass. The ball is out of play and Sheffield Utd manage to earn a corner.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' Robert Jones blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Ivo Grbic comes off his line to intercept.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
42' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.
42' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Jack Robinson (Sheffield Utd), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Sheffield Utd.

41' Jack Robinson (Sheffield Utd) displays brilliant awareness inside the six-yard box and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the middle of the target, but Djordje Petrovic keeps the ball out.
41' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Trevoh Chalobah (Chelsea) was quite harsh and Robert Jones didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
39' The cross into the penalty area from Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
39' The free kick into the penalty area from Ollie Arblaster (Sheffield Utd) is cleared.
39' Robert Jones blows his whistle. Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) commits a foul after dangerous play. Sheffield Utd will take a free kick.
38' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
37' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Marc Cucurella (Chelsea), but Ivo Grbic is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
35' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.

32' 1 - 1 GOAL! Superb work from Gustavo Hamer, who plays a vital role in the build-up. He squares it to Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd), who beats Djordje Petrovic with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner. 1:1.

31' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) gets to the rebound outside the penalty box and unleashes a long-range shot towards the bottom right corner, but Djordje Petrovic makes a decent save to stop the effort.
30' Oliver McBurnie (Sheffield Utd) tries his luck and takes a shot from inside the box. His effort on goal is blocked by a defender.
28' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat.
27' Marc Cucurella almost gets into in a promising position, but the through ball by Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) from just inside the box is intercepted by one of the defending players.
25' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
24' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) skips past his man but can't keep the ball in play.
23' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
22' Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him.
21' Ivo Grbic is alert and has a clear sight of a long through ball from Axel Disasi (Chelsea). Easy save!
18' Auston Trusty (Sheffield Utd) sends the corner into the box, but Djordje Petrovic intercepts it and averts the threat.
17' Auston Trusty (Sheffield Utd) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Sheffield Utd force their opponents to concede a corner.
15' The ball possession is 27:73.
12' Robert Jones has a clear sight and sees a foul from Conor Gallagher (Chelsea).

11' 0 - 1 Conor Gallagher produces a cross from the resulting corner and finds Thiago Silva (Chelsea) inside the box. He pulls the trigger and scores, sending the ball into the bottom left corner. What a brilliant finish. 0:1.
10' Conor Gallagher (Chelsea) steps up to send the ball in.

10' Noni Madueke (Chelsea) weaves through the defence with ease and gets one-on-one with the keeper, but fails to score with his strike towards the crossbar as Ivo Grbic produces a good save. The ball goes out for a corner. Chelsea can continue in their attacking effort.
9' A precise low pass is received by Conor Gallagher (Chelsea), who makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box, but his poorly placed shot sails well wide of the right post.
8' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) crosses the ball from the free kick, but it goes out of play.
7' Anel Ahmedhodzic (Sheffield Utd) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent. A free kick is awarded to Chelsea.
3' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) commits a foul during an attacking move.
2' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) commits a rough challenge and Robert Jones blows his whistle for an infringement.
